integrity: All exact counts and asymptotics rely on the proved equivariant functional-forest bijection and two verified weighted matrix-tree determinants; no independent mathematical audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite labeled magma monoids only, with consecutive-power stabilization and commutative limit. The proof is deductive; exhaustive tests cover only n=2,3. Earlier foundational 2022 journal full text was inaccessible, so older equivalent priority remains a risk.
title: Stationary commutative powers in finite magma monoids: an exact binomial rank law
